body_markdown:
As the healthcare industry gathers in Kansas City for the DirectTrust Annual Conference, secure data exchange and trust standards take center stage. Under the theme “Trust at the Crossroads,” this national summit addresses the evolving landscape of health data interoperability, digital identity, and regulatory compliance.


eFax® is proud to support the DirectTrust ecosystem by providing cloud communication infrastructure built on open trust standards and robust HIPAA compliance. Our intelligent document transformation tools turn unstructured documents into secure, actionable data streams ensuring vital clinical records flow seamlessly across provider networks while safeguarding patient privacy.


[Learn More](https://directtrust.org/conference)
